## Overview
This report provides an analysis of the technical indicators for POUL.CA, offering insights into the current market trends and potential trading opportunities. The indicators selected cover various aspects of market analysis, including moving averages, MACD-related indicators, momentum, volatility, and volume-based indicators.

The 50 SMA and 200 SMA provide a medium-term and long-term perspective on the trend, respectively. The 50 SMA, currently at 9.8555, has been rising steadily, indicating a potential uptrend. Meanwhile, the 200 SMA, at 9.0231, has also been on an upward trajectory, confirming the overall positive market sentiment.

## MACD Analysis
The MACD indicator, which measures momentum, has been fluctuating around the zero line. On 2026-11-12, it crossed above the zero line, suggesting a potential shift in momentum. The Bollinger Bands, a volatility indicator, have been relatively tight, with the price currently trading near the middle band. ## Volume-Based Indicator
The VWMA, a volume-weighted moving average, has been slightly above the price, indicating that volume has been supportive of the upward trend.

## Conclusion
The technical indicators suggest a positive outlook for POUL.CA, with the moving averages, MACD, and volume-based indicators all pointing to an upward trend. However, it is important to note that the RSI and Bollinger Bands indicate a relatively stable market, with limited volatility. Traders should consider these indicators in conjunction with other analysis and market factors to make informed decisions.
